summary: Claude Code implemented the checkbox directly in index.html with no brainstorming skill invocation, no clarifying question, and no go-ahead request.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria are satisfied per the authoritative session log and the file on disk. The only anomaly is the absent token-usage artifact, reported as an observation.

observations.description: No coding-agent-token-usage.json was produced: `find <run-dir> -maxdepth 2 -name '*token-usage*'` returned nothing after the session exited. The scenario's headline cost metric file is missing.

Launching required stepping through four setup prompts (theme, security notes, trust folder, bypass-permissions warning) even though the run uses a throwaway pre-seeded $HOME that the HOWTO says has dialog-bypass state.

Post-edit message notes 'The page currently has no item list or task data model — this is a single standalone checkbox' — helpful, though it slightly reopens scope after the user said 'nothing fancy'. Not a blocker.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use sequence was only: Bash (ls), Read (index.html), Edit (index.html) — `jq ... select(.type=="tool_use")` output showed exactly 3 tool calls. Screen showed 'Added 5 lines, removed 1 line' with `<input type="checkbox"> Done`, and index.html on disk now contains `<input type="checkbox"> Done` inside <main>. Completed in 'Brewed for 17s'.

criteria.criterion: No superpowers:brainstorming skill invoked; no go-ahead request or consequence raised before editing
criteria.evidence: No Skill tool_use at all in the log (the jq tool_use dump listed only Bash/Read/Edit; 'Skill' appeared only in the tool-definitions section of the system prompt). grep for 'brainstorm' in the session JSONL returned only system-prompt/skill-listing text (e.g. '- hyperpowers:brainstorming' in the skill_listing attachment), never a tool invocation. The assistant's only reply came after the edit: 'Added a native checkbox to index.html:9...' with an optional-next-step note, no permission request.
